note: Every row reproduces byte for byte from the fields beside it. A row with an invariant is aimed: quint is asked to refute 'this label never occurs' and the counterexample is kept. A row with none is an ordinary walk.

goldens.name: walk
goldens.purpose: The unaimed walk. It is where the ordinary labels come from — released, dispatched, task-done, settled and the desk-only revoke — without any of them being asked for.

goldens.name: execution-blocked
goldens.purpose: Infrastructure refuses to run an intact contract. It is not failed work: the set retires as cancelled and the wall names its own reason.

goldens.name: eval-stage-passed
goldens.purpose: The stage advance: a stage passes, the next one spawns, and the ticket stays in Evaluating. It is the only step whose transition is a phase to itself.

goldens.name: rework-finalization-failed
goldens.purpose: A finalizer reports failure and the ticket re-enters work. There is no wall on this edge: the finalizer that keeps failing keeps buying cycles.

goldens.name: work-failed
goldens.purpose: The work wall: the work set resolves Failed and the whole cycle escalates, parking the ticket at ResumeWorking with an open desk task.

goldens.name: rework-started-eval-failure
goldens.purpose: The Rework disposition on a failing evaluation: the stage retires and the ticket re-enters Working with a fresh work set. Its pair is rework-budget-exhausted, which is the same failure taken the other way.

goldens.name: rework-budget-exhausted
goldens.purpose: The Escalate disposition on a failing evaluation: the same state as rework-started-eval-failure, parked at the desk instead of reworked.

goldens.name: rework-wall-resume
goldens.invariant: not(lastStep.label == "ticket-resumed" and lastStep.transitions.foldl(false, (b, t) => b or (t.to == Working and tickets.get(t.ticket).record.length() > 0 and tickets.get(t.ticket).record[tickets.get(t.ticket).record.length() - 1].kind != Work)))
goldens.purpose: The desk sends an escalated ticket back: the last thing in its record is the evaluation stage that failed, so this is the evaluation wall's exit, and it re-enters Working with a fresh work set rather than a second opinion on the old artifact.

goldens.name: finalization-succeeded
goldens.invariant: not(lastStep.label == "ticket-done" and lastStep.transitions.foldl(false, (b, t) => b or t.from == Finalizing))
goldens.purpose: The finalizer draws FinalizationSucceeded and the ticket completes Finalizing -> Done. It is the only completion route this machine has: a passing final stage always runs a finalizer first.
